# Business Registration Pakistan

> Company registration (SECP), trademark registration (IPO-Pakistan), and taxation services (FBR: NTN, sales tax, income tax returns) for founders and businesses across Pakistan. Based in Karachi, with English and Urdu content.

Business Registration Pakistan is a consultancy that files directly with three Pakistani regulators: SECP (company incorporation: private limited, SMC, LLP, partnership, sole proprietorship), IPO-Pakistan (trademarks and copyright), and FBR (NTN, sales tax, annual returns). Content on this site is written to answer practical questions such as costs, timelines, required documents, and the difference between SECP and FBR. Government fee figures are indicative and should be confirmed against the regulator's current schedule.

Contact: hello@businessregistrationpakistan.com | +92 336 7154999 (call/WhatsApp) | Office 401, 4th Floor, Dashtiyar Center, Block 13-A, Gulshan-e-Iqbal, Karachi | Mon-Sat 10:00 AM-7:00 PM
Social: https://www.facebook.com/businessregistrationpakistann/ | https://www.linkedin.com/company/business-registration-pakistan

## Business Registration (SECP)
- [Business Registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/business-registration-pakistan.html): Register a company with SECP in Pakistan — private limited, SMC, LLP, partnership, or sole proprietorship. Fixed fees, 3–7 day turnaround, filed in Karachi, Lahore & Islamabad.
- [Company Registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/company-registration-pakistan.html): Register your company in Pakistan with SECP — private limited, SMC, or LLP. Fixed fees, 3–7 day turnaround, filed by consultants who handle every form for you.
- [Company Registration Services in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/company-registration-services.html): Fixed-fee company registration packages covering name reservation, SECP filing, and NTN registration. Get a quote agreed upfront, no hidden charges.
- [How to Register a Company in Pakistan (Step-by-Step Guide)](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/how-to-register-company-pakistan.html): A complete, step-by-step guide to registering a company in Pakistan with SECP — from choosing a structure to getting your NTN.
- [Company Registration Cost in Pakistan (SECP Fees Explained)](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/company-registration-cost-pakistan.html): SECP's company registration fees explained, by share capital slab, plus what a consultant's service fee typically covers.
- [Company Registration Documents Checklist](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/company-registration-documents.html): The exact documents you need to register a company in Pakistan with SECP, by company type — CNIC, MOA/AOA, and proof of address.
- [Company Name Reservation in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/company-name-reservation.html): Check whether your company name is available with SECP before you file — naming rules, restricted words, and how long a reservation lasts.
- [Private Limited Company Registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/private-limited-company-pakistan.html): Register a private limited company in Pakistan with SECP — two or more shareholders, limited liability, the standard structure for investment-ready startups.
- [SMC Registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/smc-registration-pakistan.html): Register a Single Member Company (SMC) in Pakistan — limited liability for solo founders, no co-founder required, filed with SECP.
- [LLP Registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/llp-registration-pakistan.html): Register a Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) in Pakistan with SECP — limited liability for consultants, law firms, and agencies with two or more partners.
- [Partnership Firm Registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/partnership-registration.html): Register a partnership firm in Pakistan with the Registrar of Firms — shared ownership between two or more partners, defined by a partnership deed.
- [Sole Proprietorship Registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/sole-proprietorship-registration.html): Register a sole proprietorship in Pakistan — no SECP filing needed, just an NTN registered directly with FBR against your CNIC.
- [MOA & AOA Drafting Services in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/moa-aoa-drafting.html): Get your Memorandum and Articles of Association drafted to match your business activity and share structure — required for SECP company registration.
- [SECP Online Registration](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/secp-online-registration.html): Register your company online with SECP through the eZfile or LEAP portal — no physical office visit required, from name reservation to certificate.
- [SECP eZfile Guide](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/secp-ezfile-guide.html): A practical guide to SECP's eZfile portal for company registration, including digital signature requirements and common rejection reasons.
- [SECP Digital Signature](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/secp-digital-signature.html): Understand why a digital signature is required for SECP's eZfile and LEAP portals, and how to obtain one for company registration and annual filings.
- [Foreign Company Registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/foreign-company-registration-pakistan.html): Register a company in Pakistan as a foreign national or overseas Pakistani — SECP process, BOI requirements, and documentation differences explained.
- [PSEB Registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/pseb-registration.html): Register your IT or software export company with the Pakistan Software Export Board (PSEB) to access tax exemptions and export incentives.
- [Chamber of Commerce Registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/chamber-registration.html): Register your business with a local chamber of commerce in Pakistan — required for certificates of origin, useful for trade networking.

## Trademark Registration (IPO-Pakistan)
- [Trademark Registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/trademark-registration-pakistan.html): Register your brand name or logo as a trademark with IPO-Pakistan. Search, file, and protect your brand for 10 years, renewable.
- [How to Register a Trademark in Pakistan (Step-by-Step Guide)](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/how-to-register-trademark-pakistan.html): A complete guide to registering a trademark in Pakistan with IPO-Pakistan — from search to certificate, in six steps.
- [Trademark Registration Cost in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/trademark-registration-cost-pakistan.html): IPO-Pakistan's trademark filing and registration fees explained, per class, plus what changes your total cost.
- [Trademark Classes in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/trademark-classes-pakistan.html): Understand Pakistan's 45 trademark classes under the Nice Classification system, with examples, so you file in the right one the first time.
- [Trademark Search Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/trademark-search-pakistan.html): Check whether your brand name or logo is already registered with IPO-Pakistan before you file — avoid rejection and disputes later.
- [Logo Trademark vs Wordmark in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/logo-trademark-vs-wordmark-pakistan.html): Understand the difference between registering a wordmark and a logo trademark in Pakistan, and which one to file first.
- [Trademark Renewal in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/trademark-renewal-pakistan.html): Renew your trademark with IPO-Pakistan before it lapses. Trademarks must be renewed every 10 years — here's how the process works.
- [Trademark Infringement in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/trademark-infringement-pakistan.html): What counts as trademark infringement in Pakistan, and what remedies a registered trademark owner can pursue against it.
- [Copyright Registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/copyright-registration-pakistan.html): Register copyright for your original literary, artistic, or software work in Pakistan — how it differs from trademark protection, and why it's worth doing.
- [IPO-Pakistan: Who Registers Trademarks in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/ipo-pakistan-trademark-registry.html): IPO-Pakistan is the federal body that administers trademark, copyright, and patent registration — separate from SECP. Here's what it actually does.

## Taxation (FBR)
- [Taxation Services in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/taxation-services-pakistan.html): Get your NTN, register for sales tax, and file annual returns with FBR. Taxation services for companies and sole proprietors across Pakistan.
- [NTN Registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/ntn-registration.html): Register for your NTN with FBR — required for every company after SECP incorporation and every sole proprietor before invoicing. Usually issued in 1–3 days.
- [Company NTN Registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/company-ntn-registration.html): Register your company's NTN with FBR right after SECP incorporation — separate from directors' personal NTNs, required before you can invoice or bank.
- [FBR Registration After SECP Incorporation](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/fbr-registration-after-secp.html): SECP incorporation alone isn't enough — here's why you also need to register with FBR immediately after, and what's involved.
- [SECP vs FBR: What's the Difference?](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/secp-vs-fbr.html): SECP incorporates companies. FBR handles taxes. Here's exactly what each regulator does, and which one you need first.
- [Sales Tax Registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/sales-tax-registration.html): Register for sales tax with FBR once your business crosses the taxable threshold — how output tax, input tax, and monthly filing work.
- [Income Tax Return Filing in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/income-tax-return-filing-pakistan.html): File your annual income tax return with FBR — required for every company and every NTN holder above the taxable threshold, even at zero income.
- [Active Taxpayer List (ATL) Status Check](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/active-taxpayer-list-status-pakistan.html): Check whether you're on FBR's Active Taxpayer List, and understand why ATL status changes the withholding tax rate you pay.
- [Withholding Tax Services in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/withholding-tax-services-pakistan.html): Understand your business's withholding tax obligations on salaries, contractor payments, and more, and how to file correctly with FBR.
- [Tax Refund in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/tax-refund-pakistan.html): Understand how tax refunds arise from excess withholding in Pakistan, and how to claim yours back through your annual FBR return.
- [Sole Proprietor Tax Filing in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/sole-proprietor-tax-filing-pakistan.html): How sole proprietors file taxes in Pakistan — business income reported on your personal FBR return, with no separate company filing.
- [Tax Filing in Karachi](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/tax-filing-karachi.html): Tax filing support in Karachi — NTN registration, sales tax registration, and annual FBR return filing, handled locally.
- [Tax Filing in Lahore](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/tax-filing-lahore.html): Tax filing support in Lahore — NTN registration, sales tax registration, and annual FBR return filing, handled locally.
- [Tax Filing in Islamabad](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/tax-filing-islamabad.html): Tax filing support in Islamabad — NTN registration, sales tax registration, and annual FBR return filing, handled locally.

- [کمپنی رجسٹریشن لاہور](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/ur-company-registration-lahore.html): لاہور میں SECP کے ساتھ اپنی کمپنی رجسٹر کروائیں — نام کی منظوری، دستاویزات، اور فائلنگ۔
- [کمپنی رجسٹریشن پاکستان](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/ur-company-registration-pakistan.html): پاکستان میں SECP کے ساتھ اپنی کمپنی رجسٹر کروائیں — پرائیویٹ لمیٹڈ، SMC، یا LLP۔ مقررہ فیس، 3 سے 7 دن میں تکمیل۔
- [NTN رجسٹریشن پاکستان](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/ur-ntn-registration.html): FBR کے ساتھ اپنا NTN رجسٹر کروائیں — SECP انکارپوریشن کے بعد ہر کمپنی اور انوائسنگ سے پہلے ہر سول پرائیویٹر کے لیے لازمی۔
- [پرائیویٹ لمیٹڈ کمپنی رجسٹریشن پاکستان](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/ur-private-limited-company-pakistan.html): پاکستان میں SECP کے ساتھ پرائیویٹ لمیٹڈ کمپنی رجسٹر کروائیں — دو یا زیادہ شیئر ہولڈرز، محدود ذمہ داری۔
- [SECP رجسٹریشن پاکستان](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/ur-secp-registration.html): SECP کے ساتھ اپنی کمپنی رجسٹر کروانے کا مکمل طریقہ — نام کی منظوری سے انکارپوریشن سرٹیفکیٹ تک۔
